column2: Not a whisky producer: "Bayadera" in this catalogue is BAYADERA.UA's own retail gift-set line (breadcrumb: Vis'ki / BAYADERA), specifically cocktail kits -- "Penicillin (11 servings)" bundles a bottle of Johnnie Walker Red Label plus a small bottle of Talisker with honey/ginger-syrup/lemon-juice mixers so the buyer can make the Penicillin cocktail at home, and "Whiskey and Apple Juice" is the same style of mixer-plus-spirit gift set. This is a retailer's own-brand product bundle, not a whisky brand or producer -- distinct from the codebase's existing bayadera store row.
